blocks.text: In star topology, all devices connect to a central hub or switch (as shown in Figure 1.9). Data passes through the central device. It is easy to manage and expand. Failure of one device does not affect others. Failure of the central hub stops the network. Star topology is widely used in modern networks.

blocks.alt: Star topology: a desktop computer, a mobile phone, a laptop and a printer each joined by a dashed link, with an arrow, to one central hub or switch.
blocks.caption: Figure 1.9: Star Topology (original drawing after the textbook's Figure 1.9).
